statements.sql: select `value`, `name` from `configs` where `team_id` is null or `team_id` = 1

select `roles`.*, `model_has_roles`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_roles`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `model_has_roles`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type`, `model_has_roles`.`team_id` as `pivot_team_id` from `roles` inner join `model_has_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `model_has_roles`.`role_id` where `model_has_roles`.`team_id` = 1 and (`roles`.`team_id` is null or `roles`.`team_id` = 1) and `model_has_roles`.`model_id` in (1) and `model_has_roles`.`model_type` = 'User'

select `permissions`.*, `model_has_permissions`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_permissions`.`permission_id` as `pivot_permission_id`, `model_has_permissions`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type`, `model_has_permissions`.`team_id` as `pivot_team_id` from `permissions` inner join `model_has_permissions` on `permissions`.`id` = `model_has_permissions`.`permission_id` where `model_has_permissions`.`team_id` = 1 and `model_has_permissions`.`model_id` in (1) and `model_has_permissions`.`model_type` = 'User'

select `announcements`.`uuid`, `code_number`, `title`, `published_at`, `options`.`name` as `announcement_type`, `announcements`.`meta` from `announcements` left join `options` on `announcements`.`type_id` = `options`.`id` and `options`.`type` = 'announcement_type' where `period_id` is null and (`announcements`.`published_at` >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00' and `announcements`.`published_at` <= '2026-11-14 23:59:59') or ((json_extract(`announcements`.`meta`, '$."pinned_at"') is not null AND json_type(json_extract(`announcements`.`meta`, '$."pinned_at"')) != 'NULL') and json_unquote(json_extract(`announcements`.`meta`, '$."pinned_at"')) >= '2026-10-07 00:00:00') order by `published_at` desc limit 10

select `events`.`uuid`, `code_number`, `title`, `start_date`, `start_time`, `end_date`, `end_time`, `options`.`name` as `event_type`, `venue`, `events`.`meta` from `events` left join `options` on `events`.`type_id` = `options`.`id` and `options`.`type` = 'event_type' where `period_id` is null and (`events`.`start_date` >= '2026-10-31' and `events`.`end_date` <= '2026-11-14') or ((json_extract(`events`.`meta`, '$."pinned_at"') is not null AND json_type(json_extract(`events`.`meta`, '$."pinned_at"')) != 'NULL') and json_unquote(json_extract(`events`.`meta`, '$."pinned_at"')) >= '2026-10-07 00:00:00') order by `events`.`start_date` desc limit 10

select `assignments`.*, `batches`.`name` as `batch_name`, `courses`.`name` as `course_name` from `assignments` inner join `batch_subject_records` on `assignments`.`id` = `batch_subject_records`.`model_id` and `batch_subject_records`.`model_type` = 'Assignment' inner join `batches` on `batches`.`id` = `batch_subject_records`.`batch_id` inner join `courses` on `courses`.`id` = `batches`.`course_id` where 0 = 1 and `date` = '2026-11-07'

select `learning_materials`.*, `batches`.`name` as `batch_name`, `courses`.`name` as `course_name` from `learning_materials` inner join `batch_subject_records` on `learning_materials`.`id` = `batch_subject_records`.`model_id` and `batch_subject_records`.`model_type` = 'LearningMaterial' inner join `batches` on `batches`.`id` = `batch_subject_records`.`batch_id` inner join `courses` on `courses`.`id` = `batches`.`course_id` where 0 = 1 and `published_at` >= '2026-11-05 10:09:17'

select `student_diaries`.*, `batches`.`uuid` as `batch_uuid`, CONCAT(courses.name, " ", batches.name) as course_batch from `student_diaries` inner join `batch_subject_records` on `student_diaries`.`id` = `batch_subject_records`.`model_id` and `batch_subject_records`.`model_type` = 'StudentDiary' inner join `batches` on `batches`.`id` = `batch_subject_records`.`batch_id` inner join `courses` on `courses`.`id` = `batches`.`course_id` where 0 = 1 and `date` = '2026-11-07'
select `meal_logs`.*, `meals`.`name` as `meal_name` from `meal_logs` inner join `meals` on `meals`.`id` = `meal_logs`.`meal_id` where `meals`.`team_id` = 1 and `date` = '2026-11-07'

select * from `holidays` where ((`start_date` <= '2026-10-26' and `end_date` >= '2026-10-26') or (`start_date` <= '2026-12-06' and `end_date` >= '2026-12-06') or (`start_date` >= '2026-10-26' and `end_date` <= '2026-12-06'))
